In the 8" FSDC meeting held on 24 October, 2013, it was inter alia decided to implement Non-Legislative Recommendations (NLRs) of the Financial Sector Legislative Reforms Commission by all Regulators. Chapter 4 of the NLRs contains the procedure for Framing of Regulations. Clauses 58 and 59 of draft Indian Financial Code provide for the regulation making process. The process of framing regulations in accordance with the draft IFC is summarized as under: 

- i. Seeking approval from board for framing Regulations and publishing the draft Regulation for stakeholder consultations. 

- il. Preparation of draft regulations. ili. Release draft regulation for public comments and suitably modified considering the comments from public. 

- iv. Placing of the draft regulations before the Insurance Advisory Committee for consultation (IRDA Act 1999 requirement) and suitably modified based on suggestions from IAC. 

- V. Approval of final regulations by the Board. vi. Notification and publication. 

The extant mechanism for framing, consultation and issuing of Regulations is issued vide circular dated 27.09.2016. 

In order to rationalize the regulation making process and to reduce the timeline for regulation making, Authority in its 119 meeting held on 26.07.2022, revised the extant regulation making process. 

The revised mechanism for framing, consultation and issuance of regulations is as per the Annexure. 

. 

This has the approval of the Authority.
